_readme: Visual configuration for /experience/lion-and-hare. All coordinates are normalized to the artwork: x = fraction of image width, y = fraction of image height (0,0 = top-left). A shot 'rect' is [x0, y0, x1, y1]: the region the camera frames (uniform scale, never stretched). 'anchorY' = where the rect's centre sits in the stage (0 top, 1 bottom). 'fit' < 1 leaves extra air around the rect. Edit freely; reload to see changes.

alt.en: Manuscript-style painting: a lion leans over a round stone well and looks at his reflection in the water; a hare sits beside the well.
alt.fa: نگاره‌ای به شیوهٔ نگارگری ایرانی: شیری بر چاهی سنگی و گرد خم شده و به بازتاب خود در آب می‌نگرد؛ خرگوشی کنار چاه نشسته است.

water._note: Ellipse of the water opening, measured from the blue pixels of the artwork. 'inset' shrinks it so ripples and clicks stay clear of the stone rim.
